claims.claim: The narrative review maps proposed AI uses across SCS selection, programming and closed-loop control while documenting major validation and governance gaps.

claims.limitation: Narrative review, not a systematic review or clinical validation study. It explicitly characterizes the AI-SCS evidence as preliminary, heterogeneous, and lacking large prospective multicenter randomized trials.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use only within the documented scope and limitations.
